message: My dinner set (ORD-1060) still hasn't arrived and it's been more than three weeks.

evidence.sql: SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.refundwise.refundwise_usl.orders WHERE order_id = 'ORD-1060' AND customer_id = 'C009'
SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.refundwise.refundwise_usl.refund_policy WHERE category = 'Home' OR category = 'ALL'

rows.rule_text: Unused items may be returned for a full refund within 30 days of delivery.
Items that arrive damaged or defective are refunded in full within 30 days of delivery; a photo is requested.
If an order has not been delivered 14 days after the order date, the customer may choose a refund or a replacement.
Items marked final sale cannot be refunded unless they are defective.
Any refund above 200.00 must be reviewed by a support lead before approval.
Customers with 3 or more refunds in the last 90 days are sent to human review to check for abuse.
An order can be refunded only once. Requests for an order that was already refunded are rejected.
When the customer's claim conflicts with order or carrier records, the case goes to human review.

proposed_decision.rationale: Order ORD-1060 was placed on 2026-10-01 and has not been delivered (delivered: false, days_since_order: 24). The not_received condition meets the 14-day threshold (24 > 14) per R4. The order total is $95.00, well under the $200.00 auto-approve limit, and the item is not final_sale. The customer has no prior approved refunds (approved_refunds_last_90_days: 0) and has not already been refunded (already_refunded: false). Per R4, the customer may choose a refund. Evidence E1 confirms the order dates and status; E3 contains the R4 policy text.

critique.reason: All factual claims are supported by evidence ids and agree with the Python checks: E1 confirms ORD-1060 order date 2026-10-01, status shipped, delivery_date null, order_total $95.00, final_sale false; E2's empty refund history confirms already_refunded false and 0 approved refunds in the last 90 days; E3 contains R4 (14-day not_received threshold, $200.00 auto-approve limit, customer may choose refund or replacement). The 24 days since order exceeds the 14-day threshold, the total is under the limit, and no blocking rules apply.

customer_reply: I'm sorry your Ceramic Dinner Set hasn't arrived yet. Since it's been 24 days since your order on October 1st, you're eligible for a full refund or a replacement. Please let me know which option you'd prefer.
limitations: No delivery tracking carrier details beyond order status were available for verification.
